SwitchPreference.android:title: Telemetry logging RAW
SwitchPreference.android:summary: Save telemetry RAW data to sdcard. They are saved to TelemetryLog at external storage (sdcard) and can be replayed in this application (.tlm)

SwitchPreference.android:title: Telemetry logging to CSV
SwitchPreference.android:summary: Save telemetry data to sdcard in OpenTX CSV format (.csv). A replay takes its clock and your position from this file, so without it a replay has neither

SwitchPreference.android:title: Ignore heights reported before arming
SwitchPreference.android:summary: Betaflight reports height above the sea while disarmed and height above the launch once armed, so the two mean different things in one flight. With this on, the heights from before arming are left out of the 3D view and the altitude profile — the positions are still drawn, on the ground

Preference.android:title: Location while the app is away

SwitchPreference.android:title: Record operator position
SwitchPreference.android:summary: Writes where you stand, how good the fix is and which way you face into the flight's CSV — playback then shows you as the recorded operator: the arrow, its ring and its line. It travels with the log if you share one.

SwitchPreference.android:title: Background compass
SwitchPreference.android:summary: Keep recording which way this phone faces while the screen is off

SwitchPreference.android:title: Automatically reconnect lost Bluetooth connection
SwitchPreference.android:summary: Try to reconnect if Bluetooth/BLE connection has failed

SwitchPreference.android:title: Automatically reconnect lost network connection
SwitchPreference.android:summary: Try to reconnect if a Wi-Fi (TCP/UDP) telemetry connection has failed

SwitchPreference.android:title: Voice messages on conection status changes
SwitchPreference.android:summary: Play voice messages when connection status chages.

ListPreference.android:title: Battery cells
ListPreference.android:summary: Divides the pack voltage to show volts per cell. Auto works it out from the pack and asks when a voltage could be two sizes. Set it by hand if you connect on a part used pack, since a low one can look like a smaller full one.\n%s
